output.text: A figure stands before a blank wall, holding an empty picture frame. He lifts it, aligning its edge with the wall. Through the frame’s open center, a passing cloud drifts across the sky. He tilts the frame, adjusting its angle. The cloud now fits perfectly within the border. He steps back, studies the composition, then repositions the frame once more. Satisfied, he bows to the wall. The empty picture frame now holds the sky. A silent moment. The passing cloud drifts on. He bows to the wall, as if honoring the moment.
